cases.review_note: Profile-dispatch rule; pure arithmetic helpers may still accept an empty auxiliary list.
The dash is canonical wire framing only and MUST be absent from the semantic V4V source entry.
Any remainder after the declared rows is trailing bytes; surplus rows are not parsed.
The empty slice is one of the entry_count declared rows, so blank-line failure precedes inspection of the surplus row.
The blank line is surplus data after all declared rows.
Complete-byte consumption is checked before declared-row semantic validation.

parser_error_precedence: header literal errors in profile/object/version order
schedule_entry_count_mismatch for too few declared rows
schedule_blank_line_forbidden for an empty declared row
schedule_trailing_bytes for any remainder after declared rows
successful reserialization as an implementation assertion
